backlog.title: Replace Winget with Chocolatey + PowerShell installer
backlog.description: Swap the Windows distribution channel from Winget (blocked by winget-pkgs Defender gate) to Chocolatey (goreleaser-native chocolateys: pipe, no acceptance gate) plus a PowerShell installer (irm | iex, the Windows curl|sh analog). The upgrade subsystem must detect Chocolatey installs and PRINT 'choco upgrade stagecoach -y' (admin, never self-swap). All Winget references in code, CI config, and docs must be eliminated.

milestones.title: Upgrade subsystem: Chocolatey replaces Winget in detect + delegate
milestones.description: Replace the ChannelWinget constant, detection probe, path heuristic, and delegation logic with Chocolatey. Chocolatey is a PRINT channel (admin — FR-U4), not a RUN channel like Winget was. Includes all unit test updates.

tasks.title: Replace Winget with Chocolatey in detect + delegate (+ unit tests)
tasks.description: Surgical swap of the winget channel for chocolatey across the upgrade detection cascade (detect.go) and delegation dispatch (delegate.go). Chocolatey is detected via 'choco list --local-only stagecoach' (exit0Confirm) + a ProgramData path heuristic, and delegates to a PRINT channel ('choco upgrade stagecoach -y') because choco owns the binary and needs admin (FR-U1/FR-U4).

subtasks.title: install.ps1: create PowerShell installer at repo root (irm | iex Windows analog of install.sh)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/020_6979db625159/architecture/external_deps.md for the install.ps1 behavioral spec. install.sh (repo root, 9002 bytes) is the direct functional template — it documents the exact asset-naming convention (stagecoach_<v>_<os>_<arch>), checksums.txt verification, and STAGECOACH_INSTALL_METHOD tagging that install.ps1 must mirror. install.ps1 does NOT exist yet (confirmed: does not exist anywhere in the tree).
2. INPUT: install.sh (repo root) as the structural template. The GitHub Releases API pattern from internal/upgrade/releases.go. The SHA256 verification pattern from internal/upgrade/download.go. Spec §21.3 (install paths).
3. LOGIC: Create install.ps1 at the repo root. It must: (a) Detect arch via $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE (AMD64→amd64, ARM64→arm64). (b) Resolve the latest release tag via GitHub Releases API (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/dabstractor/stagecoach/releases/latest, unauthenticated). (c) Download stagecoach_<v>_windows_<arch>.zip + checksums.txt from the release assets. (d) SHA256-verify the zip against the matching checksums.txt line (hard gate — Write-Error + exit 1 on mismatch, like install.sh and download.go). (e) Extract stagecoach.exe to $LOCALAPPDATA\stagecoach (use System.IO.Compression.ZipFile — no PowerShell gallery modules). (f) Prepend $LOCALAPPDATA\stagecoach to the USER PATH via [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', ..., 'User') (NOT Machine — no admin required). (g) Set STAGECOACH_INSTALL_METHOD=direct in the USER environment via [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('STAGECOACH_INSTALL_METHOD', 'direct', 'User'). (h) Print a success message with 'Re-open your terminal for PATH changes to take effect.' (i) Add a header comment block cross-referencing spec §21.3 and explaining this is the Windows analog of install.sh. Keep it dependency-free.
4. OUTPUT: install.ps1 exists at repo root. A PowerShell syntax check (powershell -NoProfile -Command '& { . ./install.ps1 -DryRun }' or pwsh -NoProfile -File install.ps1 -WhatIf, or at minimum a parse check) confirms it is valid PowerShell. The script follows the irm | iex invocation pattern: 'irm https://github.com/dabstractor/stagecoach/raw/main/install.ps1 | iex'.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] install.ps1 itself IS documentation (header comments). docs/packaging.md coverage of the PowerShell installer is handled in P1.M3.T1.S1.
